mapping: exact approved symbol preferred, else unique HGNC previous-symbol match; single Entrez ID unique in raw matrix; reject multi-symbol Entrez and ambiguous or generic aliases; retain original signature names
normalization: log2(1 + CPM), denominator all raw matrix genes per sample; no length inference, not TPM/FPKM
score_reference_cohort: all author-matched pretreatment patients including unknown response; no on-treatment samples in gene z standardization
limitations: current HGNC snapshot not original 2017 annotation; previous cohort use and assay differences remain; no response analysis performed here
